properties.title: Diesel spill, Midnight Chief, San Juan Harbor, Puerto Rico
properties.content: On the morning of December 9th, 176-foot Panamanian ro-ro container ship Midnight Chief spilled, during fueling, approximately 600 gallons of diesel fuel in the San Antonio Channel of San Juan Harbor, Puerto Rico.

properties.title: Helena Star sunk, Tacoma, WA
properties.content: On January 25, 2013 the 167 ft M/V HELENA STAR sank in the Hylebos Waterway in Tacoma, WA. The NOAA SSC was requested on 28 February to look at proposed salvage/clean-up actions in regards to possible affects to the surrounding environment.

properties.title: Rig Explosion, West Delta 45, LA
properties.content: On 16NOV12, a platform exploded while workers were cutting pipe. USCG said the platform was not actively producing oil and it is not belived that there is any chance for a major environmental disaster. The platform was for oil and natural gas production. The location is ~9 nm from LA coast and current efforts are focused on Search & Rescue and Damage Control. NOAA is engaged (OR&R-ERD and NWS) with USCG to support efforts and will provide services as requested.

properties.title: Leaking Pipeline, Offshore LA
properties.content: At 1145 CST on 30MAR, USCG MSU Morgan City contacted NOAA SSC about a leaking pipeline in GOM. The source is about 55 miles SW of LA and has been leaking intermittently since 23MAR. Divers and a jetting barge are on-scene trying to locate the source point and repair the pipeline. The natural gas condensate leaking from the pipeline has created a sheen. On-scene air monitoring is generating safety concerns. USCG has requested sheen trajectory information and plume modelling.
